# Security & UX Requirements Checklist: User Profiles, Account Menu Bubble & Public Commenter Views

**Purpose**: Peer PR review checklist validating the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of privacy/RLS/storage security and Neo-Brutalist Light/Dark UX & accessibility requirements for `003-user-profiles`.
**Created**: 2026-11-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | **Plan**: [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Privacy, RLS & Storage Security Requirements

- [ ] CHK001 Are the exact public vs. private field boundaries for `public.profiles` explicitly enumerated and consistent across `spec.md`, `data-model.md`, and `contracts/profile-routes-and-actions.md`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Data Model §2.1]
- [ ] CHK002 Are database-level access controls (column-level `SELECT`/`UPDATE` grants and `votes_select_own` RLS) specified for direct PostgREST queries in addition to Next.js Server Component projections? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Spec §SC-005, Data Model §2.1–2.2]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the authentication and redirect/gating behavior for unauthenticated requests to `/profile` unambiguously defined? [Clarity, Spec §US2-AS1, Contracts §1]
- [ ] CHK004 Are avatar upload constraints quantified with exact pixel dimensions (`<= 256x256`), client-side byte limits (`<= 200 KB`), server-side bucket limits (`<= 500 KB`), and allowed raster MIME types (`image/webp`, `image/jpeg`, `image/png`)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Data Model §2.4]
- [ ] CHK005 Are ownership-scoped Storage RLS requirements (`INSERT`, `SELECT`, `UPDATE`, `DELETE` restricted to `{user_id}/*`) completely specified for both initial upload/upsert and photo removal? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Data Model §2.4]
- [ ] CHK006 Are error-handling and state-preservation requirements defined for unsupported file types (e.g., SVG, PDF) and corrupted image uploads? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Contracts §4.2]
- [ ] CHK007 Are egress-protection requirements (prohibiting `SELECT *`, `abstract_text`, and `embedding` vectors) consistently applied to `/profile` upvoted studies and `/profile/[id]` comment history queries? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, Contracts §2]

## UX, Accessibility & Neo-Brutalist Dark Theme Requirements

- [ ] CHK008 Are all five required elements of the `AccountBubble` popover (identity summary, `Profile` link, `Light`/`Dark` toggle, conditional `Admin Review Queue` link, `Sign out`) and their visibility rules (`role === 'admin'`) explicitly specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Contracts §5.2]
- [ ] CHK009 Are keyboard navigation, focus restoration, and dismissal requirements (`Enter`/`Space`, `Escape`, click-outside light dismiss, route-change close) defined for the `AccountBubble` trigger and popover? [Coverage, Spec §FR-002, Research §4]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the deterministic 2-letter initials derivation rule (`deriveInitials`) unambiguously specified for single-word names, multi-word names, extra whitespace/punctuation, and empty fallbacks? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, Contracts §5.1]
- [ ] CHK011 Are all Neo-Brutalist Light and Dark theme color tokens (`--color-canvas`, `--color-surface`, `--color-ink`, `--color-muted`, `--color-border`, `--color-accent`, `--color-accent-ink`, `--shadow-card`, `--shadow-control`) explicitly defined with zero purple/violet/indigo hues? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, Contracts §5.3]
- [ ] CHK012 Are contrast requirements for `#38BDF8` Sky Blue accents and semantic pastel evidence badges (`#0F172A` dark ink in both Light and Dark themes) clearly documented? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, Contracts §5.3]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the complete theme lifecycle (Light default for unauthenticated visitors, zero-FOIT pre-paint initialization on ISR routes, profile persistence on toggle, and revert-to-Light on sign-out while preserving saved profile preference) free of contradictions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, Spec §SC-004, Data Model §3]
- [ ] CHK014 Are pagination boundaries (`20` items per page, most-recent-first ordering, `"Load more"` control) and zero-data empty states clearly specified for both `/profile` activity lists and `/profile/[id]` comment history? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-007, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK015 Are input validation rules and inline error/counter behaviors defined for `display_name` (`2–50` non-whitespace chars), `bio` (`<= 160` chars), and `affiliation_role` (5-value enum or none)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Spec §Edge Cases, Contracts §3]
- [ ] CHK016 Are `/profile/[id]` error and not-found states (invalid UUID or unknown user ID) and `/study/[id]` discussion attribution links (`UserAvatar`, display name, optional role tag) clearly specified? [Coverage, Spec §US3-AS1, Spec §US3-AS4, Spec §FR-009]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
